title: Bellman policy-evaluation lab
description: Hold one policy fixed and watch synchronous Bellman sweeps turn local expectations into a global value function.
ready: Evaluator ready. Run one synchronous sweep or continue to the tolerance.
working: Rust is computing the next synchronous Bellman sweep.
paused: Paused after {sweep} sweeps. Current Bellman residual: {residual}.
failed: The evaluator could not start. The chapter text remains available.
resetDone: Values and residual history were reset to V₀ = 0.
limitReached: The configured sweep limit was reached before the tolerance.
deterministic: Deterministic computation · no random seed required
heatmapBody: Select a state to inspect its latest backup. Color strength follows the value magnitude.
stateAria: State s{state}, {name}, current value {value}, exact value {exact}
backupBody: A synchronous sweep reads every next-state value from the previous vector, then writes the whole new vector at once.
backupPrompt: The table shows the current Bellman target. Run a sweep to record its old and new values as a Rust update event.
dependenciesBody: The fixed policy and environment together induce these transition probabilities. An arrow means one state's backup reads another state's previous value.
graphAria: Directed Bellman dependency graph for four states
graphDescription: Seven labeled arrows show which previous state values each Bellman backup reads. The numeric transition table below contains the same probabilities and rewards.
matrixBody: Each row of Pπ sums to one. Rust solves the same four equations directly to provide an independent reference value.
convergenceBody: The plotted quantity is ‖TπVₖ − Vₖ‖∞ for the current vector. Iteration stops only when it is no larger than ε.
historyDescription: A logarithmically scaled line traces the current Bellman residual after each completed synchronous sweep. The table below contains every plotted value.
noHistory: Run a sweep to extend the residual trace.
auditBody: These checks compare the live Rust snapshot with independently recomputed invariants in the presentation layer.
auditRows: Every Pπ row sums to one
auditFinite: All values and residuals are finite
auditExactResidual: Direct solution satisfies the Bellman equation
auditScope: The experiment evaluates a fixed policy; it does not optimize one
modelNote: s₃ is terminal. Entering it yields the listed transition reward; later terminal self-loops yield zero.

errors.evaluation_discount_range: The discount factor must be finite and at least 0 but less than 1.
errors.evaluation_tolerance_range: The tolerance must be finite, greater than 0, and no greater than 1.
errors.evaluation_max_sweeps_range: Maximum sweeps must be an integer from 1 through 10,000.
errors.evaluation_unknown_state: The requested teaching-model state does not exist.
errors.singular_bellman_system: The Bellman linear system could not be solved.
errors.evaluation_restore_sweeps: The stored sweep count is outside the configured limit.
errors.worker_error: The experiment Worker reported an unexpected error.
